given.note: Refused: booking-page-start.json's request answered as opened while carrying A3-24's emergency line. An opened request carries only a line that lets a booking go on after it (A3-23, A3-26, A3-49, A3-50); an emergency, crisis words and an unsure read never open a request (arch 02 line 129; A3-24, A3-25; arch 06 line 323). The one fault is outcome.safetyLine's fixedLineId safetyEmergency; with safetyLine null it is booking-page-start.json and accepted.
